newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares close steady, EMU dominates day.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares close steady, EMU dominates day.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly higher on Wednesday at the end of an eventful day in which the European Commission forecast Italy's deficit/GDP ratio would jump to 3.9 percent in 1998 after hitting 3.2 percent in 1997.
The all-share Mibtel index closed 0.22 percent higher at 12,279 with the Mib30 finishing just 0.15 percent higher at 18,287.

Brokers said insurance stocks were particularly weak after negative sentiment towards the sector's prospects took hold. Generali closed 1.54 percent lower at 29,474 lire and SAI fell 1.42 percent to 12,936 lire.
Credito Bergamasco closed 1,215 lire higher at 29,450 lire after yesterday's announcement by Credit Lyonnais that it was selling a controlling stake in the bank.
Fiat and ENI were stable, closing 0.22 percent and 0.28 percent higher at 5,587 lire and 8,881 lire respectively.
"The news that Italy could make the three percent deficit target if it adopts structural measures helped but the market closed flattish towards the end," said a Milan-based broker.
